payload.text:
Every acceptance criterion passes, and `node --test` passes 10/10. The branch's own tests already cover the API criteria, so I added no tests and made no commit.

The page criterion has no automated test, because the project has no DOM test setup. I checked it by reading `public/index.html`. `render()` appends ` (due YYYY-MM-DD)` as a text node only when the todo has a due date, and appends an empty string otherwise.

The verdict is `success`, and the test report is attached to it.
